review: I want tight, fair routes, and half of this build does not give me one. Spike Garden is broken: the mid player stands beside a spike for 45 seconds and 98 of 100 ghosts fail. Spring Loaded is upside down: the weak player finishes while the strong ones stall before the second spring. Gauntlet stops nearly everybody at the laser-plus-spring chokepoint, so the finale has no flow. Laser Gate kills at two seconds, before I can read the cycle. Saw Mill and Ferry Lines are honest skill checks, and Crumble Bridge is the one stage I would grind for time. First Steps is safe but flat.
best: Crumble Bridge keeps me moving with a real penalty for hesitation and a clear, fast line to the goal.
worst: Spike Garden and Spring Loaded stall skilled players with no way forward, which is a route defect and not a challenge.
